markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (84%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
The 90% conformal set retains Normal and InSitu (15%), so in situ cannot be excluded [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 84%, InSitu 15%, Benign 1%, Invasive 0% | Normal lead; InSitu second |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% target, 90% coverage) | InSitu remains possible |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability, 16% OOD, 12/12 kept [F6] | Typical input; QC passed |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Normal (80%), 1/5 InSitu [F5] | Mostly Normal matches |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score (-1.91); 0/20 AI spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 2, 5) · ↓ invasive · High score (-1.39) opposes invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Below-typical (-0.19); 8/20 spot check [F4] · Weak
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 0, 2, 4) · context · 3 neoplastic nuclei (region 2); insufficient tumor flag · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops risk beyond random (CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); **Normal lobules** is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal in situ carcinoma exists, matching 90%-similar InSitu case BACH_0043 and 15% InSitu probability.
- Unsampled regions hold atypia; HoVer-Net only measured regions 0, 2, 4 (3 neoplastic nuclei).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 7, 11**: Verify two-layered epithelium; **Normal lobules** concept is Unreliable (0/20 spot check).
2. **Regions 2, 3, 8**: Inspect region 2 (neoplastic nuclei), region 3 (ducts), and region 8 (risk).
3. **Regions 1, 2, 5**: Confirm benign stroma; consider drafted deeper levels or CK5/6, ER stains.
